SELECT 
    stg_dim_chemical.owner, 
    stg_fact_chemical.value
FROM 
    stg_dim_chemical
JOIN 
    stg_fact_chemical ON stg_dim_chemical.id = stg_fact_chemical.id
JOIN 
    stg_changes_chemical ON stg_fact_chemical.id = stg_changes_chemical.id
WHERE 
    stg_dim_chemical.name = 'Reactor R-01' AND 
    stg_fact_chemical.date = '2026-01-15' OR 
    stg_fact_chemical.date = '2026-03-15'
